Viewer layout and 3D presentation

Fixture-only verification, 18 September 2026. All 3D images below are actual Chromium WebGL renders using SwiftShader—not SVG approximations or fallback screens.

  • 181 unit tests and app TypeScript check passed.
  • 40 interactive browser conformance checks passed, including visible and operable header controls at 768 × 600 and 840 × 600 landscape with the panel still exactly 480px wide.
  • 61 selectable model elements × 8 viewports = 488 selection checks; no constrained placements in this walkthrough. 49 elements per viewport were selected through panel rows; 12 model-only opening-perimeter edges used the live viewport selection callback because they have no individual panel rows.
  • Widths:375,390,767,768,1024,1279,1280,1440. Labels stayed contained, without label/control overlaps after layout settled.
  • 35 raw hex occurrences and 28 palette utility occurrences replaced; zero remain in scoped viewer implementation outside token definitions.
  • Fixture values, measurement calculations, legacy viewer, card spacing/rails, bottom quality content, 480px side panels and unrestricted camera controls preserved.

Limits: Physical phones/iPads, native Safari touch and hardware-specific rendering are not verified. Extreme pan/zoom can still exceed available label space; the viewer reports the constraint instead of hiding labels or restricting orbit. Existing repeated-selection camera-distance drift was not changed because camera framing was explicitly out of scope.

Complete token contract

The 16 entries in the final proposal table are proposed—not derived from the reference—and await approval.

# Viewer v4 runtime tokens

Runtime source: `artifacts/aufmass-app/lib/viewer-next/tokens.ts`. Its `viewerTokens` export is the single named runtime source; `viewerTokenStyles` exposes every entry as `--viewer-<kebab-name>`. Values are primitive strings/numbers.

All `L…` citations below refer exactly to `docs/viewer-reference/desktop.html`; context identifies the original declaration or script object. Hex values retain the reference value exactly (including channel values), rather than screenshot sampling or approximation.

## Brief-defined constraints (not HTML design tokens)

These are behavioural, geometry, or accessibility requirements from `.local/tasks/viewer-responsive-rendering-polish.md`, not values derived from the desktop HTML and not entries in `viewerTokens`: exactly two portrait states (split/full model, L8 and L15); phone controls below `768px` (L16); `44px` minimum touch targets plus accessible names and clear active states (L16 and L22); phone dimension/tooltip labels at `14px` (L19); all text at least `12px` (L19); and a `260px` minimum model viewport height in split state (L15). They must remain implementation constraints rather than being presented as reference styling.
